preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, the number of residents n and the number of friendship pairs m must satisfy 1 <= n <= m <= 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair (a_i, b_i) must have both a_i and b_i within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for _ in range(t)) <= 10**6 and sum(m for _ in range(t)) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: The total number of residents and friendship pairs across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: Output 'No' if it's impossible to select jury and contestants, otherwise output 'Yes'.

postconditions.expression: j + p == n and j >= 1 and p >= 1
postconditions.description: The number of jury members j and contestants p must sum to n, with both j and p being at least 1.

postconditions.expression: len(jury) == j and len(contestants) == p and all(jury[i] != contestants[i] for i in range(j))
postconditions.description: The jury and contestants must be distinct sets of indices, with no overlap between them.
